summary: Read a circular list of integers. After the final entry, the walk continues at the opening entry. For every element, start one seat ahead of it and walk forward around the circle until you meet the first strictly larger value. Write that value when it exists. Write -1 when a walk that returns to the start finds nothing larger. The answer has the same length as the input, and answer i belongs to element i. An element is not larger than itself, and an equal value is not larger. Walk only forward around the circle, never backward.
notes: Compare after trimming trailing newlines. The input is tokens in the same order as the method parameters.
